summary: Most first-time full-time students at four-year schools are awarded some aid.
realLife: In 2020-21 about 87 percent were awarded aid at four-year schools and 82 percent at two-year schools.
inGame: needs: an aid award on the college-started record.

turns.what: The student gets no aid, because the family's income is too high or the forms were late.
turns.pulledBy: household income and a filing date
turns.writesBack: an unfunded first year on the record

turns.what: Aid arrives in the second year after a form is fixed.
turns.writesBack: a second-year grant on the record
